jobs.title: Atamis - Director of Product and Technology
jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. About Atamis Atamis is a growing software business based in Cardiff. We make source-to-contract procurement software that is trusted across the NHS and the wider public sector, and used by private sector organisations too. We have a strong customer base, a product our customers rely on every working day, and a clear ambition: to move from software that records and reports on procurement to software that does the work. Every year the UK public sector spends hundreds of billions of pounds buying goods and services, and every pound is taxpayers’ money. Much of that buying is still slow and manual. Buying teams spend their week writing specifications, chasing quotes and justifying decisions, while suppliers, large and small, spend heavily on every bid. Atamis is on a mission to change how that work gets done. As we grow, our team is expanding so we can keep delivering high-quality solutions to our customers. About the role You’ll lead Product and Technology as one function and report to the CEO. The big question is how procurement should work if it were designed around AI from scratch: what AI should do, what a person must decide, and how a buyer can trust and defend the result. jobs.title: Staff Research Engineer
jobs.description: About the job Turn AI research ideas into experiments that help shape Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware. As a Staff Research Engineer in Graphcore Research, you’ll help shape complex projects from hypothesis to evaluation. You can join the team in Bristol, London or Cambridge. Our research spans efficient training and inference, numerics, reinforcement learning, and more. You’ll build implementations and algorithms that scale and explore how choices in model design and execution affect hardware efficiency. Your work will help to push AI models past the frontier, while turning the results of your work into recommendations that silicon and software engineers can use in their designs. You will explain to various groups which trade-offs matter as models grow and where bottlenecks emerge. You’ll also prepare papers and present findings at AI conferences and specialist workshops.  The team and culture Researchers across Bristol, London and Cambridge shape projects around shared research interests. You might work with colleagues to investigate how a model scales,  trace a distributed inference bottleneck, or develop an algorithm that enables training with more efficient number formats.  Research team bring a customer perspective and experience making models and software work on Graphcore’s stack at scale. Together, the teams develop ideas in efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference. Graphcore Research works with research groups around the world and publishes at venues including NeurIPS, ICML and ICLR. What we’re looking for A PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline such as mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics or chemistry. Python skills with a framework such as PyTorch or JAX, with experience in model design, optimisation, evaluation and scaling. jobs.description: About Volta Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds. jobs.description: The Role As a Forward Deployed Engineer Intern, you work on the technical side of our customer relationships, before and after the deal. jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description: About us Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About the team The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. About the role The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models. As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers. We are looking for a motivated student or recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science or a related field and a solid foundation in Python and data processing, available to start in early 2027. Own your models end-to-end — from data pipelines and modelling to deployment and monitoring. Improve the scalability and reliability of our existing ML data pipelines. Work closely with software engineers and product managers to turn business problems into practical solutions. Be the Data Science expert in a small Data Products team alongside two data engineers and one data analyst. Identify where ML and GenAI can solve real product and business problems, and choose the right approach. Work with our platform and LLM Ops teams when additional infrastructure support is needed. Your profile 5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning solutions in production. Strong knowledge of statistics and classical ML, with good judgment about which approach fits the problem, scale, and cost. You’re proactive and comfortable working on problems that aren’t fully defined yet. You communicate clearly and work well with both technical and non-technical colleagues. English at C1 level or above. Nice to have Experience with AWS, Terraform, or dbt. Experience working with LLMs or GenAI-based solutions. German language skills. jobs.description: Szukamy doświadczonego inżyniera Linux/SRE do zespołu zajmującego się utrzymaniem i rozwojem infrastruktury HPC oraz klastrów GPU wykorzystywanych do AI. Pracujemy na fizycznych serwerach, z Linuxem, sieciami Data Center i technologiami NVIDIA. Dużo automatyzujemy, korzystamy z Ansible, Pythona, Basha i Gita. To nie jest typowa praca DevOps skupiona na chmurze i wdrażaniu aplikacji. Tutaj zdecydowanie więcej czasu spędza się na pracy z infrastrukturą, diagnozowaniu problemów i dbaniu o stabilność środowiska. Mile widziane Doświadczenie z HPC, klastrami obliczeniowymi lub infrastrukturą GPU. Znajomość technologii NVIDIA (Cumulus, DCGM, NCCL, NHC, NVIDIA Container Toolkit). Znajomość InfiniBand, RDMA, SLURM. Doświadczenie z Prometheus, Grafana, GitLab CI/CD. Doświadczenie z rozproszonymi i klastrowymi systemami plików (Lustre, Ceph). Kim jesteś (Soft Skills)? jobs.description: SwissBorg is building the future of crypto wealth management, making investing more accessible, transparent and intuitive for everyone. At the core of our platform is the Meta-Exchange (MEX). This smart routing engine connects multiple exchanges and liquidity sources to deliver optimal execution in a single, seamless app. We're Swiss-engineered, regulated, and trusted by nearly one million users managing over $1B in crypto assets. But beyond the numbers, what drives us is the people behind every wallet and a commitment to continuously improving how they experience and interact with crypto. Join us! Are you studying accounting or finance, or about to finish your degree, and looking for real, hands-on experience in an international group? We have an exciting opportunity for you! SwissBorg is a crypto wealth management platform operating through a group of regulated entities across Switzerland, France, Estonia and other jurisdictions. We are looking for a part-time Accounts Payable Intern to join our small accounting team. You will handle the day-to-day supplier invoice process and learn how accounting works in a multi-entity group, with the support and supervision of our accounting team. This is a hands-on role. Some tasks are routine, but accuracy and consistency are what keep our financial operations running smoothly, and you'll learn a lot along the way. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Your Impact Engineering has changed, and we're changing with it. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead one or more teams into AI-native software delivery, building products used by thousands of eCommerce merchants worldwide. We're not hiring for where engineering was. We're hiring for where it's going. You'll lead one or more engineering teams and help shape how they build software as AI reshapes the craft. You'll stay close to the work, coach your engineers, and help your teams move towards agentic workflows, with quality and security built in. We build on and around Shopify, which moves just as fast, so staying current is part of the job. You'll work from our Leicester city centre office three days a week, with two days remote, reporting to CTO. What you'll do Lead, coach and grow your engineers across one or more teams, building a culture of learning and technical excellence. Own your teams' delivery, working with Product, Design, QA and DevOps to ship high-quality work on time. Apply the architecture team's direction, and improve the scalability and performance of your teams' systems. Raise AI maturity across your team or teams against our maturity model, from prompt, context and harness practices towards agentic loops. Keep building with new tools yourself. Follow our AI development standards, including review of AI-generated code, and flag tooling gaps that slow the team down. Balance tech debt, reliability and feature delivery. Run incident response for your teams' systems and lead post-mortems. Take part in hiring, and support your engineers' performance and growth, including their AI fluency. What you'll bring 5+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years leading engineering teams. A degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience. jobs.description: Pilotez les missions où se jouent les paris IA des grands groupes, et transformez-les en résultats mesurables L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes. Et tout commence par vous.   Missions En tant qu’ AI Strategist Manager , vous construisez avec les dirigeants de nos clients une stratégie IA crédible, un modèle opératoire adapté et un programme de transformation qui génère une valeur mesurable. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier. And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights. The mission: build the world s largest network for private equity investors. You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel. If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply. Why CFO Insights CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow s innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries. CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one. What we offer you Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world s most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act. Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts. Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale. Ownership fro

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - ClickPipes Platform
jobs.description: About the Team The ClickPipes team builds the services that power data ingestion into ClickHouse Cloud. As a primary entry point for customers’ data, ClickPipes is critical to product adoption and the company’s growth. We work at petabyte scale, solving challenges in distributed systems, fault tolerance, and high-throughput ingestion. You’ll help make these pipelines performant, reliable, and easy to operate, with ownership of technical decisions and the platform as a whole. You can find some of the team’s recent work highlighted in our blog: GCP Pub/Sub connector for ClickPipes is now in Private Preview Terraform & OpenAPI for ClickPipes is now Generally Available Unordered mode for GCS ClickPipes is now available We’re looking for backend engineers with experience in data-intensive systems who enjoy working across technologies. You’ll collaborate with engineering and product partners and drive projects from design through production. What will you do? Build and evolve integrations with streaming platforms and object storage, including Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage. Continuously improve our systems based on operational metrics, customer feedback, and evolving business requirements. Drive technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions that impact our platform's scalability and resilience. Participate in on-call rotations to ensure system reliability and respond to production incidents. About you: 5+ years of software development experience building and operating distributed systems. Strong knowledge of Go and its ecosystem. Experience designing systems for scalability and fault tolerance, with an understanding of concurrency, consistency, and failure recovery. Understanding of cloud-native architecture and practical experience with at least one major cloud provider. Experience diagnosing and resolving production issues in distributed systems. Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate across engineering

Joining an established, high-performing Dutch sales team, you'll bring your commercial expertise, market understanding and independent approach to winning new business, while continuing to grow your expertise in payments and fintech. jobs.title: Service Desk Analyst
jobs.description: What is the job? This is not your usual service desk job. You'll be the person our clinicians, pharmacists and office teams think of when they think of IT and, one of a very small team that makes technology work across a regulated, growing healthcare business. Some days that means sorting a laptop for a new starter. Others it means getting a prescription printer back online before the afternoon dispatch, helping open a new office, or working out why a process keeps breaking and fixing it for good. We're a scale-up that still feels like a start-up: things move fast, priorities shift, and there's rarely a playbook. We want someone who finds that energising, not exhausting. This role will suit a self-starter who wants to make a positive difference. We care as much about how you work with people, how you think and how you own things than about the certificates on your CV. What will you be doing? Be the face of IT. Look after people across our offices and remote teams, in person and within the dedicated slack channel. Fix things, explain things, and leave people more confident than you found them. Keep the pharmacy running. Own the reliability of the printers, scanners and devices behind prescription dispensing, where downtime directly delays patients' medicines. Run identity and access well. Manage joiners, movers and leavers across Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID, carefully and on time, because in a regulated business access matters. Look after devices. Set up, secure, track and retire laptops and phones, and help shape how we manage them as we grow. Help build what's next. Get hands-on with new office fit-outs, network and security projects, supplier rollouts and tooling changes. Fix root causes, not just tickets. jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel - Product & AI (Part-time)
jobs.description: Amsterdam (hybrid) | Part-time (freelance) 8 hours a week | €2,000 to €2,500 per month Foleon is a leading content creation platform providing business teams with a fast and scalable way to produce highly-engaging content experiences that bring a new level of intelligence to their customer journeys. Foleon is based in Amsterdam and New York and serves more than 1,200 global B2B brands. We value people who are bold, ambitious, collaborative, and customer-centric. Even better, the ones who know how to work hard and have fun at the same time. We’re a team of highly driven people, with a great sense of human connection and a clear focus. Your Mission As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR. Your Job Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early. Lead compliance for our AI proposition: classify our AI use cases, map our obligations as a provider or deployer under the EU AI Act, and set up the documentation, transparency and governance it requires. jobs.description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. jobs.title: Occupational Health & Safety Expert , Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (f/m/d)
jobs.description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop. You are the subject-matter expert Orbem relies on for the hard safety calls: you set the standards, build the systems behind them and lead the safety projects that matter most. You work with a high degree of autonomy. Your impact comes from technical depth, influence and mentoring. You decide independently on risk assessment methods, technical standards and corrective actions, align with management on measures with high cost or cross-team impact, and escalate imminent dangers and legal non-compliance early. Your Day-to-Day Legal Occupational Safety: You perform all duties of a designated occupational safety specialist under § 7 ASiG and ensure compliance with the relevant regulations (ArbSchG, GefStoffV, BioStoffV, StrlSchG, ArbStättV). Safety Strategy & Systems: You own Orbem’s cross-functional OHS: risk assessments, incident management and compliance frameworks, including a legal register, standards, templates and escalation paths. Subject-Matter Expertise: You are the key expert for safety in laboratory and MRI environments (magnetic fields, hazardous and biological substances) and set the standard for quality

Veel uitzoekwerk dus, en lang niet elke aanvraag levert uiteindelijk werk op. Dat zien we terug in elk land waar we actief zijn, van Nederland tot Denemarken. Bij 12Build ben jij eigenaar van het product dat daar verandering in brengt. We zoeken een AI-native productmanager voor Team Sellers, het team dat 12Build bouwt voor onderaannemers en leveranciers. Je hebt een goed gevoel voor product, voelt je thuis in data en werkt al dagelijks met AI-agents. Bovenal ben je graag bij klanten en werk je graag met mensen. Zo doen we productwerk bij 12Build. Designers, developers en PM’s werken allemaal met agents, en we verbeteren die workflows continu om de weg van klantsignaal naar release korter te maken. jobs.description: Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.). Contexte et missions Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale. Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales. Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins. Définir les objectifs de perte de données admissible (RPO) et de délai de reprise (RTO), ainsi que les politiques de rétention, de chiffrement et d’immutabilité. Wir planen und bauen unsere Anlagen selbst. Dadurch entstehen spannende, praxisnahe Projekte mit echtem Einfluss auf Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourcenschonung. Deine Aufgaben – technisch, vielseitig, praxisnah Konstruktion und Entwicklung von Maschinen, Baugruppen und kompletten Anlagen für die Aufbereitung von Mineralik und Metallen Erstellung technischer Zeichnungen und Konstruktionsunterlagen für unsere Anlagen (2D/3D) Berechnung von Durchsatzmengen, Materialflüssen, Energiebedarf und mechanischen Belastungen Erstellung von technischen Zeichnungen, Stücklisten (BOM), Montageanleitungen sowie Durchführung von Risikobeurteilungen nach der EU-Maschinenrichtlinie (CE-Kennzeichnung) Enge Abstimmung mit Vertrieb, Projektleitung, Einkauf, Fertigung sowie den Montageteams vor Ort beim Kunden Das bringst Du mit abgeschlossenes Studium im Maschinenbau, der Verfahrenstechnik, Umwelttechnik oder eine Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker (Fachrichtung Maschinentechnik) Erste Erfahrung im Bereich Anlagenbau, Maschinenbau oder Konstruktion wünschenswert Sicherer Umgang mit CAD-​Programmen (z. B. AutoCAD, SolidWorks o. ä.) jobs.title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
jobs.description: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production. HOW you will contribute You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor. Every topic follows the same path: Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter. A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3. Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result. You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results. Topics for 2027 Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you. jobs.title: Head of Hardware
jobs.description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors. You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them. This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. jobs.title: QA Engineer (EN)
jobs.description: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams. What you'll do Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building; Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why; Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable; Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses; Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority; Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release; Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing; Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features. What you bring A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field; At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer; Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans; Experience with test automation and test frameworks; You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and

jobs.title: QA Engineer (NL)
jobs.description: Over de rol Bij YoungOnes zorg jij ervoor dat ons platform doet wat het belooft: stabiel, betrouwbaar en zonder verrassingen voor de mensen die het elke dag gebruiken. Als QA Engineer werk je niet aan het eind van de keten, maar middenin onze ontwikkelteams. Je denkt mee vóórdat er code geschreven wordt, test slim waar het telt en bent de brug tussen development, product en de rest van het bedrijf als het om kwaliteit gaat. Je valt onder de Teamlead Frontend en werkt dagelijks samen met de frontend-, mobile- en backendteams. Wat ga je doen Meedenken vanaf het begin. Je schuift aan bij refinements en helpt teams de risico's en impact van een feature te zien voordat ze gaan bouwen; De juiste testaanpak kiezen. Samen met het team bepaal je per feature wat je automatisch test, wat je handmatig test en waarom; Geautomatiseerde tests bouwen en onderhouden. Je zet tests op voor belangrijke functies van het platform en houdt ze betrouwbaar; Handmatig en verkennend testen. Je gaat zelf door de app heen, zoekt naar randgevallen en vindt wat een script mist; Centraal aanspreekpunt voor bugs. Bugmeldingen uit het hele bedrijf komen bij jou binnen. Je reproduceert ze, verzamelt alle informatie die een developer nodig heeft om ermee aan de slag te gaan en zet ze met de juiste prioriteit klaar in Jira; Adviseren over releases. Je brengt risico's in kaart en geeft een duidelijk advies over de kwaliteit van een release. Inzicht geven. Je verzamelt testdata en laat zien hoe het met de kwaliteit van onze software gaat. Balans bewaken. Je helpt teams de afweging te maken tussen bugs oplossen en nieuwe features bouwen. Wat breng je mee Een hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in informatica, software engineering of iets vergelijkbaars. Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring, waarvan minimaal 1 jaar als QA Engineer, Software Tester of Test Automation Engineer. Ervaring met het opzetten en uitvoeren van een testaanpak en testplannen. Ervaring met testautomatisering en testframeworks. Je werkt vlot

Über unseren Mandanten Unser Mandant ist eine international tätige Unternehmensgruppe mit zahlreichen Gesellschaften und Niederlassungen. Die zentrale IT in Düsseldorf betreut die gemeinsame SAP-S/4HANA-Landschaft für mehrere Länder. Warum diese Rolle? Zugleich nimmt die Nutzung von Fiori zu, und das Berechtigungskonzept wird auf das neue Fiori-Berechtigungsmodell von SAP erweitert. Weil jede Integration neue Fragen stellt und Sie die Antworten gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen erarbeiten. Weil Sie ein großes, gewachsenes Rollenmodell verantworten und seine Struktur mitbestimmen. Weil Sie den Fiori-Ausbau aus Berechtigungssicht von Anfang an gestalten. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben Sie analysieren bei jeder Integration neu zugekaufter Geschäftsteile die Tätigkeiten, bewerten mit den Fachbereichen die passenden Rollenprofile und prägen die Sammelrollen über Organisationsebenen für die neuen Gesellschaften aus, inklusive Prüfung und Nacharbeit. jobs.description: inspire AG is the leading Swiss competence centre for product innovation and advanced manufacturing. As a strategic partner of ETH Zurich, our mission is to transfer knowledge and technology from research to Swiss machine, electrical and metal industries. The research group Intelligent Production Systems at inspire is based in Lugano, the southern part of Switzerland. This position sits at the interface between research and industry. jobs.description: Qui sommes nous ? Depuis plus de 22 ans, le groupe Dans le Noir ? fait découvrir une expérience sensorielle et humaine hors du commun à travers ses restaurants, spas et espaces sensoriels. Le concept repose sur une immersion dans l'obscurité totale, où les repères habituels disparaissent pour laisser place aux autres sens et favoriser une nouvelle façon de vivre les échanges et les expériences. Plébiscité par la presse et le grand public, le groupe est aujourd'hui présent dans 9 pays et 15 villes (Paris, Nantes, Bordeaux, Strasbourg, Toulouse, Marseille, Tours, Londres, Bruxelles, Lisbonne, Saint-Pétersbourg, Luxembourg, Genève, Mexico et Le Caire). Ses restaurants ont accueilli plus de 2,5 millions de visiteurs et font l'objet de près de 1 000 articles dans la presse internationale. Ouvert en octobre 2021, le restaurant de Toulouse est né d'un partenariat avec l'hôtel 4 étoiles Pullman Toulouse Centre Ramblas, aujourd'hui devenu le FirstName Toulouse, situé sur les allées Jean-Jaurès. Vos missions Sous la responsabilité du « Project Manager » et en collaboration quotidienne avec lui, vous participerez au bon fonctionnement et au développement de Dans le Noir ? Toulouse . Vous pourrez également être en contact direct avec la Directrice du développement international de Dans le Noir ? pour des missions ponctuelles. Les missions seront variées et pourront être dans les domaines suivants : RELATION CLIENTS & FLOOR - OPÉRATIONNEL Présence terrain principalement sur les temps forts du restaurant (minimum 3 soirs/semaine : jeudi, vendredi, samedi). Rôle de runner (coordination entre la cuisine et les guides-serveur en salle noire) : préparation du tableau de suivi de service, envoi des plats & boissons, suivi du bon déroulement du service Accueil des clients, débriefing post-expérience auprès des clients Suivi, organisation et supervision des réservations et demandes clients COMMUNICATION & RÉSEAUX SOCIAUX Animation des réseaux sociaux du restaurant (Instagram, Facebook)

jobs.description: We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. jobs.description: About 3Y Health 3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry. About the role Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. What you'll do Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex Our stack Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform
